name: Phenonip
description: Phenonip (CAS 8066-38-4 ) is a broad-spectrum preservative blend combining phenoxyethanol with a mixture of parabens, formulated specifically for effective antimicrobial protection in cosmetic and pharmaceutical systems. It delivers reliable preservation against bacteria, yeast, and mould across a wide range of formulation types and pH conditions. In rinse-off and leave-on cosmetic formulations it protects finished products from microbial contamination. Common applications include lotions, creams, shampoos, and conditioners where it ensures product integrity throughout shelf life. Pharmaceutical topical preparations such as ointments and gels also rely on it for preservation efficacy. The blend is essential during stability testing and regulatory review for various topical treatments. In adhesive and sealant manufacturing, it functions as an in-can preservative, preventing microbial degradation of water-based systems. Its oil-soluble character allows direct incorporation into the oil phase of emulsions, simplifying production workflows for formulators. This versatility makes it a preferred choice for complex chemical manufacturing processes. The product is supplied as a pale yellow to amber liquid and is available in cosmetic and pharmaceutical grades. Specifications are aligned to established industry standards for preservative blends used in personal care. Standard packaging includes drums and intermediate bulk containers suited to industrial procurement volumes.
